scope: Corollary 3.5 (Growth of the limiting spectral rates) of the manuscript “Universality of critical quench autocorrelations in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model” (preprints/Universality-of-critical-quench-autocorrelations-in-the-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-model-October-5-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 12d511db42d09b8c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For GOE-almost every g, and every b with b + g1 > 0, there are finite positive constants cg,b, Cg,b such that cg,b(1 + i)2/3 ≤ gi + b ≤ Cg,b(1 + i)2/3 (i ≥ 1). (3.35) They can be chosen measurably when b is a measurable admissible function of g.
